item.title: If you really want those Pokémon Lego Kanto region badges, you can expect to pay over £100 on eBay thanks to scalpers
item.description: Yesterday, Lego fully unveiled its official Pokémon sets, which include the rather chonky Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise model. This chap was notable not only for its size and price tag (it is retailing for £579.99), but the fact that if you pre-ordered it, you would also get your hands on the Lego Pokémon Kanto Region Badge Collection as a gift with purchase while stocks lasted. Read more

item.title: Ubisoft continues new wave of layoffs as 55 jobs are expected to be cut at Massive and Stockholm offices
item.description: French publisher Ubisoft is promising a nostalgic 2026, with remakes of Assassin’s Creed 4: Black Flag and Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time nearing completion, and the first Division game also getting a re-release of sorts. For many of the developers at key studios, however, the year is off to an awful start. Read more

item.title: New documents and videos give us another alleged look at Monolith Productions’ cancelled 2010 Batman game
item.description: Monolith Productions' closure last year remains one of the hardest gut punches the Western games industry has seen recently. From iconic shooters like FEAR to the inventive Shadow of Mordor & Shadow of War, the studio always excelled, no matter the genre. Now, unearthed materials allegedly recovered from a discarded HDD used at the studio have revealed work done on a non-Arkham Batman game for Warner Bros. Read more

item.title: Anthem was abandoned in death as in life: it's a game EA and BioWare would rather forget
item.description: It's gone. In case you didn't know, the servers for BioWare's multiplayer game Anthem have been switched off, rendering this online game no longer playable. For all intents and purposes, Anthem no longer exists. Read more

item.title: Oops! Funko Pop might have just spoiled a Fallout Season 2 plot point
item.description: Oh, Funko Pop. What have you done? Well, unless my eyes are deceiving me, I think you may have let slip a yet-to-be-aired and potentially pivotal plot point for the second season of Amazon's Fallout adaptation. Read more

item.title: Story-driven strategy game Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown beams down Switch 2 version and release date
item.description: Before 2026 heats up, we've got several small and mid-sized game releases coming our way fast, but unexpected arrivals like Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown could be making the coming weeks busier than initially anticipated. Read more

item.title: Could Anthem live on? Tech allowing us to host our own servers existed, former executive producer says - it would just need to be "salvaged and recovered"
item.description: BioWare's multiplayer shooter Anthem was terminated this week because EA no longer wanted to maintain servers for people to play the game on, and without them, no one can play the game. But the former executive producer of Anthem has revealed that BioWare had technology working, close to the game's release, that would enable us to host our own servers to play the game on. Read more

item.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is finally getting a physical Switch 2 release, and it's not a game-key card
item.description: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds didn't cause a commotion when it launched last year, but it quietly became a compelling alternative to Mario Kart World's offerings, which many felt were on the simpler (albeit extremely polished) side. Now, a little over a month since the native Nintendo Switch 2 version arrived digitally, we've got confirmation the physical release is coming in March. Read more

item.title: Code Vein 2 is a blood-curdling Souls-like that's looking like a 2026 sleeper hit
item.description: Would you believe me if I told you Code Vein 2 is one of the most enjoyable Souls-like games I've played in years? That it not only improves upon systems and quirks present in the original game, but also offers something truly fresh in a genre packed with fierce competition? It's all true! After playing Bandai Namco's upcoming sequel for a few hours I can confidently say it's a bloody good time, and with enough depth that even the most hardened action game fans can sink their teeth into. item.description: Styx: Blades of Greed is probably one of my most anticipated games this year, so I am pleased to let you know that there is now a demo available to try out. Read more
